name: The Snow Queen is Uncool
source:
It's winter solstice, and Berta should be out there doing her job as an arbiter of mortals, but she prefers to laze around at home instead. This terrible character flaw has almost led to her disappearing from humanity's radar! On her own, she'll have no idea how to fix this... Thankfully, her loyal, brilliant, enterprising and very humble manager knows just the way to save her from obscurity.

[From [url=https://omure.itch.io/the-snow-queen]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
今天是冬至。貝爾塔本該出門，履行裁決凡人的職責，可她寧願賴在家裡。這個糟糕的性格缺陷，已經讓人類幾乎忘記了她的存在！光靠她自己，恐怕根本不知道怎麼補救……幸好，她那位忠心耿耿、才華橫溢、銳意進取，還特別謙虛的經紀人，正好知道怎樣讓她不再默默無聞。

〔摘自[url=https://omure.itch.io/the-snow-queen]itch.io[/url]〕
